history.content: What kind the material can I recycle and put in a compost bin?

You can recycle and put the following materials in a compost bin: leaves, vegetable scraps, straw, coffee grounds, wood chips, alfalfa, sawdust, grass clippings, newspaper, manure from herbivores, cardboard, and garden waste. It's important to avoid adding feces from cats and dogs, invasive plants, weed seeds, oil, fats, plastics, or non-organic matter to your compost bin.
